description: Return the enrichment record for one company: name, domain, industry, employee_count, description, last_updated (ISO 8601 UTC) and source. Call this when you already know the company's website domain or exact name and need firmographic details. Pass exactly one of `domain` (preferred; URLs like "https://www.acme.com/about" are normalized to "acme.com") or `name` (case-insensitive exact match). If you only have a partial name or a topic, call search_companies first. Returns error "not_found" when no record exists. Paid: $0.01 USDC per successful call on Base Sepolia via x402 (send the payment in request _meta "x402/payment"; an unpaid call returns the payment requirements). Lookups that fail, such as not_found, are not charged. For a free preview, use search_companies.

domain.description: Company website domain or URL, e.g. "acme.com"

name: get_company_enrichment
title: Get company enrichment
